title: Repair V11 generic recovery locator uniqueness
mission: Repair the concrete generic-recovery projection defect exposed by Chromium CI run 36653361714: four rendered locator entries collapse to two unique IDs. Trace the duplicate identity source, make locator identity/deduplication deterministic without hiding distinct recovery items, add a bounded regression, and rerun the existing V11 served Chromium CI. Do not alter Current/Served/Human Accepted authority.
definition_of_done: The duplicate-locator cause is isolated from the existing generic recovery projection and exact source path is recorded.
Rendered recovery locator entries have deterministic unique identity or are semantically deduplicated while preserving genuinely distinct recovery items.
A repository regression fixture covers the observed 4-entries/2-unique failure and fails closed on malformed/unknown identity.
The existing V11 served Chromium CI is rerun and the generic_recovery_projection_uniqueness check passes against the repaired served bytes.
No Current, Served, Promoted, Catalog or Human Accepted authority is changed.
